scope: Focused final source art:11 fresh ordinary keyboard-equivalent Model states and6 explicitly reused source-bound QA terminal snapshots;2 actual source runtime sequences and12 no-op DOM layouts. No repeated three-round record run, APK, physical-device, video or browser-earned-win claim.

testProvenance.freshStates: Three actual initial boards, rotate, mirror, twice-mirror with charged budget, same-color mirror before/after, one public edge-only counterexample, one short public-plan win and5400 neutral ticks to genuine90s timeout. External planner/focus APIs receive detached public JSON with underscore-prefixed fields removed. No author route or forced arrangement/outcome/time/budget is read or written.
testProvenance.reusedStates: Six complete final.model snapshots are consumed from the already passed unique QA integration:one record-paced win and one genuine budget loss for each level. Every origin records exact file/hash/source hashes and snapshot field. These terminal Model states are rendered without rerunning those six rounds.
testProvenance.runtime: Two original shared-runtime sessions use real browser Enter/Space/B/P events to start, rotate, mirror and pause, producing five screenshots per viewport. They do not earn wins. Twelve explicit no-op layout snapshots cover six states at960/1280:8 fresh-input-derived views and4 reused-QA-terminal views. These are not restored simulations or browser-earned outcomes.
testProvenance.storageLimitation: Both viewport sequences share the source-art browser context. After the960 no-op QA-won layout, shared runtime stores best1765; later1280 menu/play images may display that fixture-derived best. This is not a1280 browser-earned score or a claim of a clean persistence session. The current1280 board still comes from original create and changes only through real A/B/P; actual candidate/final QA uses separate browser contexts.
testProvenance.renderPurity: Deep-freeze/JSON equality, throwing private/underscore/hidden getters on state and entities, and a throwing PureModel proxy guard rendering. External time/raw inputs do not change commands/HUD/result. Measurements map every actual sprite angle and label to current public tile/slot/sector identity, color and polygon.
testProvenance.connectivity: Only public shared edges marked matched get cross-seam connections; mismatches get crosses, and every actual vertex is capped without a color bridge. The renderer does not compute or invent color-component goals. Current/target RGB rows come directly from colorRegions. Accepted six-fan mathematics allows edge-only counterexamples but not correct-region/wrong-edge ones; no contrary independence claim is made.
testProvenance.performance: Headless Chromium SwiftShader WebGL1 actual drawElements count is1 in all17 cases, one1024 atlas texture, GL0, maximum424 quads. Context restoration reproduces pixels. No physical GPU/TV claim.
testProvenance.deduplication: One approved source-art generation passed. No quick3 or cadence matrix was added; no source correction or rerun was needed. Raw report and all40 original PNGs remain unchanged.

wordingConclusions: A and B both cost1; B is fixed-axis mirror, never undo. BB restores physical arrangement while keeping two charged moves.
Same-color mirror explicitly says marks moved and cost1; actual labels exchange while color-region counts stay unchanged.
Only the public current arrangement is shown. Separate shared-edge/RGB rows do not claim mathematical bidirectional independence.
The ordinary all-edges-correct/regions-wrong state stays playing. Accepted boards require the actual model goal.
Won/lost display settled physical marks, no selected action or last-operation guidance; result copy distinguishes move limit and90s timeout.

findings: All40 generated PNGs were opened and visually reviewed:17 canvas states,10 real source-runtime frames,12 explicitly no-op DOM snapshots and one512px icon.
Enamel facets, material-specific textures, color letters and stable numeric sector marks are distinct. Tile IDs remain separate from those moving marks.
The selected fixed mirror axis and bright triangle outline do not obscure the labels. A, B, BB and equal-color B show the actual physical permutation; cost/status text remains separate from MOVES.
All six shared edges may agree while the RGB distribution is wrong. The measured edge-only state remains active and the unequal red/blue counts are visibly shown.
Both viewport sizes retain the full sidebar, short help/tip, readable count hierarchy and blurred menu/pause/result dialogs. Terminal reasons have no orphan lines or stale operation prompt.
The decorative512px icon matches the original enamel theme without disclosing an authored arrangement.

rootVisualReview.scope: Personally opened eight actual source-art PNGs. Full-canvas states, original-runtime playing-960, explicit QA-terminal/no-op DOM fixture and icon are distinguished; no APK/device/video claim.
observations: Painted enamel/glass sectors, graphite seams, physical color/mark labels and tile IDs are distinct and consistently positioned.
Real first mirror swaps R3 and G2 while B1 stays on fixed edge. Two mirrors restore the initial physical layout with MOVES 2/6.
Repeated-color mirror shows B2/B3 exchanging positions, current color-region counts unchanged, and explicit MARKS MOVED, COLOUR SAME / COST 1 footer without overlap.
All shared edges can show 6/6 while separate RGB region counts remain wrong, with no premature victory claim.
The 960-pixel playing screen and explicit QA-won layout preserve full sidebar/help/version; won modal backdrop is blurred.
Icon visually matches the original three-color triangular enamel theme.
